text: Pre-verified patch ready for your Resource Hub access slice. I did NOT commit any change to server/research/index.ts, layout.tsx or auth-return-to.ts - I applied the admission to a local working copy, measured it, and reverted (branch shows zero changes to those files). Deliverables on fable/recruiter-resource-hub-20260906: docs/resource-hub/locked-gate-admission.patch (12 added lines, exact diff) and docs/resource-hub/locked-gate-safety-bar.mjs (runnable probe), with the measurement written into docs/resource-hub/LOCKED_GATE_ADMISSION_NOTE.md. RESULT under PREVIEW_LOCK_GATE=1: before, library and delivery both 401; after, 200 and 200-with-PDF-bytes and the whole safety bar passes 19/19 - rep sees only what rep may see, affiliate cannot see rep-only metadata or fetch its bytes (404 not 403), member without a partner record 404 partner_not_found, suspended empty + 404, withdrawn and draft-policy denied, unknown uuid 404 with no ledger row, malformed id refused at the wall with 401 before the handler, no bearer and invalid bearer refused, no write method admitted on either path, no unrelated partner path opened, no storage key/admin identity/review reason in any response. Reproduce both states: start the harness with PORT=5232 PREVIEW_LOCK_GATE=1 node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/preview-resource-hub.ts, then BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5232 node docs/resource-hub/locked-gate-safety-bar.mjs. You still own applying it plus the layout.tsx exemption and the auth-return-to entry, and re-running the gates on the combined tree. This is my evidence, not an independent acceptance.
